title: The build store records no images, so nothing can wait for them
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach images (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 7)

evidence.verified: tests/test_repin_go.py's image test passes: a local build whose entry awaits two images is left out and named until a file for each exists, then taken. For real, sandbox's `make ci` at its pushed head recorded the build awaiting sandbox and sandbox-slim, and `cs-sandbox build` and `cs-sandbox build --slim` then wrote both files under images/sandbox/. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 7f94c70.

resolution: A project that publishes images names them in `CS_BUILD_IMAGES` when it records, and its entry lists them under `awaits`. An image build of the commit writes a file for each under images/. The repin takes the build only once all of them are there, and names a newer one still waiting.
details: The status file lists a commit of a project that publishes images only once its images are published. The build store has no such rule, and no place to put images at all. A local build of sandbox is listed as soon as `make ci` passes, before any image of it exists. A sibling that pins it then names an image no host has built.
